title: nuxt-backend doctor --json
description: What `npx nuxt-backend doctor --json` prints, and the DevTools panel's Copy doctor JSON copies. The process exits 1 when any finding fails.

findings.description: Every check that ran, in report order. `--only` limits them to some services.

summary.description: One line: `auth ✓` when nothing needs attention, otherwise the count and the ids of the findings that warn or fail.

id.description: Stable across releases: a removal or rename follows the deprecation cycle in STABILITY.md.

service.description: The part of the app the finding is about, and the name `--only` selects it by.

title.description: A short label. Its wording may change in any release.

status.description: `fail` breaks the app or a deploy; `warn` is a designed degradation or an unreachable check; `pass` is healthy.

message.description: What the check found. Its wording may change in any release.

fixHint.description: What to do about it: a command when there is one. Empty for a pass.

docsUrl.description: The finding's entry in the docs: https://nuxt-backend.dev/d/<id>.
